readiness.eligibleRowsDefinition: Rows are shown for review only. No hospital or source-observation records are proposed or imported.
blockers: This utility is strictly read-only; a separate reviewed implementation would be required to write source observations.

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (hospital_id) REFERENCES hospitals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((source_email IS NULL) OR (length(btrim(source_email)) > 0)) AND ((source_contact_phone IS NULL) OR (length(btrim(source_contact_phone)) > 0)) AND ((source_nodal_officer_name IS NULL) OR (length(btrim(source_nodal_officer_name)) > 0))))

CHECK (((source_row_payload IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(source_row_payload) = 'object'::text) AND (source_row_payload ?& ARRAY['source_document'::text, 'source_date'::text, 'source_page'::text, 'record_type'::text, 'pdf_entry_number'::text, 'hospital_id'::text, 'hospital_name'::text, 'hospital_name_source'::text, 'hospital_type'::text, 'email'::text, 'email_source'::text, 'nodal_officer_name'::text, 'contact_number'::text, 'contact_number_source'::text, 'verification_status'::text, 'extraction_review_status'::text, 'extraction_notes'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'source_document'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'source_date'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'source_page'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'record_type'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'pdf_entry_number'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'hospital_id'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'hospital_name'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'hospital_name_source'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'hospital_type'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'email'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'email_source'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'nodal_officer_name'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'contact_number'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'contact_number_source'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'verification_status'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'extraction_review_status'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_row_payload -> 'extraction_notes'::text)) = 'string'::text))))
CHECK (((expires_at IS NULL) OR (last_verified_at IS NULL) OR (expires_at >= last_verified_at)))
FOREIGN KEY (hospital_id) REFERENCES hospitals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (verified_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX hospital_source_observations_document_hash_idx ON public.hospital_source_observations USING btree (source_document_sha256)
CREATE INDEX hospital_source_observations_hospital_history_idx ON public.hospital_source_observations USING btree (hospital_id, source_date DESC) WHERE (hospital_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospital_source_observations_identity_unique_idx ON public.hospital_source_observations USING btree (source_system COLLATE "C", source_hospital_id COLLATE "C", source_document_sha256 COLLATE "C")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospital_source_observations_pkey ON public.hospital_source_observations USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX hospital_source_observations_unlinked_review_idx ON public.hospital_source_observations USING btree (source_date DESC, source_system) WHERE (hospital_id IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX hospital_verification_records_hospital_history_idx ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (hospital_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospital_verification_records_one_current_idx ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (hospital_id) WHERE is_current
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospital_verification_records_pkey ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX hospital_verification_records_status_idx ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (status, last_verified_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX hospital_verification_records_verified_location_gix ON public.hospital_verification_records USING gist (verified_location)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospitals_pkey ON public.hospitals USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX hospitals_public_city_listing_idx ON public.hospitals USING btree (lower(public_city), public_listing_status) WHERE (public_city IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX hospitals_public_listing_name_idx ON public.hospitals USING btree (lower(public_name)) WHERE (public_listing_status = 'published'::hospital_listing_status)
CREATE INDEX hospitals_public_location_gix ON public.hospitals USING gist (public_location)
